answer: Draw juries by stratified sortition. Each identity is filed in a stratum keyed by its funding root and join week; a public randomness beacon picks 7 distinct strata per jury, then one member inside each. A farm of 1,000 clones in one stratum still gets at most 1 seat, the same odds as a lone sparrow. Carrying a 4-of-7 verdict means controlling 4 strata, and owning half of 2,000 strata needs ~1,000 separately funded roots joined across different weeks. Failure mode: laundered funding; strata whose votes match above 90% across 50 juries are folded into one branch of the trellis.
